posts.title: 5 Tips for Better Cardio Sessions
posts.intro: Improve your cardio performance with these simple yet effective techniques to maximize stamina and recovery.
body: Start with a clear goal for each session. Alternate between steady-state runs and interval days to avoid plateaus.
Warm up for at least 8-10 minutes to elevate your heart rate and prepare your joints for impact.
Track intensity using a perceived effort scale and keep most sessions in the moderate zone.
Hydrate early, not just mid-workout, and prioritize a balanced recovery meal within an hour.
highlights: Consistency beats intensity. A slightly shorter workout you finish is better than a long one you skip.
Add a short mobility sequence after training to keep hips and ankles resilient.
posts.about: Maya specializes in endurance programming and has helped hundreds of runners build sustainable, injury-free training habits.

posts.title: Meal Prep Basics for Gym Enthusiasts
posts.intro: Fuel your workouts with balanced, easy-to-prepare meals. A guide on planning, prepping, and staying consistent.
body: Pick three core proteins, two complex carbs, and a mix of vegetables you enjoy. Rotate sauces to keep variety.
Batch cook grains and proteins, then store them in portioned containers for grab-and-go meals.
Keep snacks simple: nuts, fruit, and yogurt provide quick energy without heavy prep.
highlights: Plan once, eat well all week. A two-hour prep session saves time every day.
Freeze half your portions to avoid taste fatigue and reduce food waste.
posts.about: Jordan is a sports nutrition coach focused on simple, sustainable habits for active clients.

posts.title: Building Core Strength: Exercises and Benefits
posts.intro: A strong core is essential for stability and injury prevention. Learn the best exercises to enhance your power.
body: Start with anti-rotation drills like Pallof presses to build deep core stability.
Progress to dynamic movements such as dead bugs, plank variations, and suitcase carries.
Pair core work with breathing drills to improve posture and overall strength transfer.
highlights: Train your core in multiple planes to support real-life movement patterns.
Consistency and control matter more than speed in core training.
posts.about: Emma focuses on foundational strength and mobility, helping athletes move with confidence.
